text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, as I walked by the 
central courtyard—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Have you seen Flower!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We have an emergency on our hands, yes! If 
we don't find it soon...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep beep beep beep beep)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, we did it! Time's up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No! I lost again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I searched all over the place, but I 
couldn't find it anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Flower is the hide-and-seek champion, yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"T-Taiki-senpai, you're praising me too 
much. I'm happy, but it's a little 
embarrassing..."
choice_data_list:
Are you playing hide-and-seek, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a game my little sisters 
absolutely loved!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is the final game. If Flower stays 
hidden until the very end... a reward hug 
for you!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'll give you a big squeeze, nuzzle 
you, and tell you what a good girl you 
are!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah... Taiki-senpai, um... Since 
we're here, could we do one more... um...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's true! Since Trainer's here too, 
let's play a three-player game next time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now then, both of you, go hide, pleeeease! 
I will absolutely find you before time 
runs out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Taiki Shuttle ran off toward 
the tree and began counting.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I have to make sure I don't get caught 
next time either. Ehehe... I haven't lost 
a single time yet, you know."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"There was nowhere to hide, so I thought 
I'd definitely get spotted, but they 
didn't catch me once!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even when I was "it," I was able to find 
Taiki-senpai right away, so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I might actually be pretty good at 
hide-and-seek!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I was feeling down just a moment 
ago, but somehow I'm feeling all cheered 
up now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I couldn't run the way I wanted to... 
and that's when Taiki-senpai came over and 
spoke to me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"If you laugh a lot, your blues will go 
flying away!" she said.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Every time I hid well, they praised me, 
and it made my heart feel all warm and 
fuzzy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, we have to hurry and hide!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll go hide over there. Good luck to you 
too, Taiki-senpai's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just one minute after Taiki Shuttle began 
searching—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu... I sense Trainer's presence 
around here, you know~? Why don't you come 
out~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Trainer-san, spotted! You won't get 
away~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried running away at full speed, but 
there was no way I could beat Taiki 
Shuttle's legs—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're pretty good at this yourself, 
Trainer! In that case, I'll get serious 
tooâgot it!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*Staaare...* Is this a staring contest? 
I'm not going to lose, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
――YES! I just heard the sound of rustling 
leaves! Trainer-san, you're right over 
there, aren't you~?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, if you think you can escape from 
this Wild Gunman, you are sorely mistaken, 
*desu ne*~!
choice_data_list: To think it'd be found so easily...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san is an adult, so I won't tease 
you like I do with the Little Sisters!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now then, next is Flower, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Flo~we~r! Where are you~? Even if I have 
to run all over the academy, I will find 
you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, pretending not to notice 
Nishino Flower's tail peeking in and out 
of sight, Taiki Shuttle continued playing 
the seeker with a wide grin on her face.
